episodeTitle.en: The surprising truth about what closes deals: Insights from 2.5m sales conversations | Matt Dixon
episodeTitle.zh: 《成交背后的惊人真相：250万次销售对话的洞察》|马特·迪克森

guestBioOfficial.en: Matt Dixon is one of the world’s foremost experts in sales and the author of The Challenger Sale, which sold over a million copies worldwide and was a #1 Amazon and Wall Street Journal bestseller. His most recent book, The JOLT Effect, focuses on overcoming customer indecision—one of the biggest challenges to closing deals. Outside of writing, Matt co-founded DCM Insights, a boutique consultancy helping organizations understand customer behavior, and is a frequent contributor to the Harvard Business Review, with more than 20 print and online articles to his credit. In our conversation, we discuss: • Why 40% to 60% of qualified sales opportunities are lost due to customer indecision
guestBioOfficial.zh: 马特·迪克森是全球销售领域的顶尖专家，《挑战者销售》一书全球销量超百万册，并登上亚马逊和《华尔街日报》畅销书榜单。他最新著作《JOLT效应》聚焦克服客户犹豫不决——这是成交的最大挑战之一。除写作外，马特还联合创立了DCM Insights，这家精品咨询公司帮助组织理解客户行为，并为《哈佛商业评论》撰写20余篇纸质版与网络版文章。在对话中，我们将探讨：•为何40%至60%的合格销售机会因客户犹豫不决而流失

title.en: The surprising truth about what closes deals: Insights from 2.5m sales conversations | Matt Dixon
title.zh: 《成交背后的惊人真相：250万次销售对话的洞察》|马特·迪克森

summary.en: Matt reveals that most deals are lost not to competitors but to customer indecision driven by fear of failure, and that dialing up FOMO backfires 87% of the time. He lays out the JOLT method - judge indecision, offer a recommendation, limit exploration, and take risk off the table. The episode also revisits the Challenger Sale's lessons on leading the customer's thinking.
summary.zh: 马特揭示，大多数交易不是输给竞争对手，而是输给由"害怕搞砸"驱动的客户犹豫，且制造紧迫感（FOMO）有 87% 的概率适得其反。他给出了 JOLT 方法——判断犹豫、给出建议、限制选择、消除风险。本期还重温了《挑战式销售》中关于"引领客户思考"的要点。
